label: Fill holes
tooltip: Closes small holes in the scan.
nothingToDo: There are no holes up to this perimeter.
syntheticHint: New triangles do not count as scan data: fitting, segmentation and deviation leave them out.
help: Holes up to the set perimeter are closed; their borders are marked green. Large open areas stay open, because filling them would invent a surface. Holes do not need to be filled for fitting.
